steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: I surrender! Lord, surrender! Lord Hecate, stop!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Chief, do you want to continue? Please give the order.
She jumps straight off the roof and falls face down before you with a thud. She might as well just wail with her arms around your legs.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: The new Chief of Minos Bureau of Crisis Control is so brave and awesome! I was wrong to underestimate you. Please forgive me, Chief!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: So who was the one beating me up?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: No one, no one! I wouldn't dare! My electricity can do nothing other than making someone numb. It certainly can't kill! Your teammates are all fine, Chief!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: I have no choice in Syndicate. I need to know how to fake it to survive! B-but I'll repent of my ways!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wow! how embarrassing for the "Archer Queen of Syndicate!" So are you gonna work for the Bureau as a lapdog now?!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Shut up! At least I've embraced freedom, but what about you? You couldn't even get out of your cage, am I right?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Cut the crap and arrest her first.
If you will fight for me.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Huh? No, no, no! I'm just a useless loser. I can't be of much help. Please stop! Hey! Stop it! St—stop—

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: At least don't put me in the front row in a fight!!!
